payload.prompt: Erstellen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Buchhaltungsdimension "Prosjekttype" mit den Werten "Internt" und "Utvikling". Buchen Sie dann einen Beleg auf Konto 6340 über 44500 NOK, verknüpft mit dem Dimensionswert "Internt".

payload.goal: Create a custom accounting dimension 'Prosjekttype' with values 'Internt' and 'Utvikling', then post a voucher to account 6340 for 44500 NOK linked to dimension value 'Internt'.
success_checks: Custom dimension 'Prosjekttype' exists in Tripletex with exactly two values: 'Internt' and 'Utvikling'
Voucher is posted to account 6340 with amount 44500 NOK
Voucher line is linked to dimension value 'Internt' under 'Prosjekttype'
Voucher is balanced (debit = credit) and accepted by the ledger
Dimension value 'Internt' is visible on the posted voucher in the ledger report
risk_notes: Custom dimensions may require a specific Tripletex module to be enabled (e.g., 'Dimensjoner' / custom dimension module) — verify module activation before proceeding
Account 6340 must exist in the chart of accounts; if not, it must be created or mapped first
No counter-account specified for the voucher — a balancing account (e.g., bank or accounts payable) is required for a valid double-entry posting; this is ambiguous in the prompt
No VAT rate specified; account 6340 is typically a cost account — VAT treatment is unclear and may default to exempt or 25% depending on configuration
No voucher date provided — system date will be assumed unless specified
No description/reference for the voucher was provided — may be required by Tripletex validation
Dimension API endpoint names may differ between Tripletex versions; confirm correct endpoint for custom dimensions
payload.suggested_first_action: Enable the custom dimensions module in Tripletex via PUT /module or company settings, then POST to the custom dimension endpoint to create 'Prosjekttype' with values 'Internt' and 'Utvikling'.

line_items.description: Voucher posting to account 6340 linked to dimension value 'Internt'

ordered_steps: 1. Enable custom dimensions module via Tripletex company settings or PUT /v2/module if not already active
2. POST /v2/accounting/dimension (or equivalent) to create custom dimension 'Prosjekttype'
5. Verify account 6340 exists via GET /v2/ledger/account?number=6340; create if missing
6. Identify or create a balancing counter-account (e.g., bank account or AP account) for double-entry
7. POST /v2/ledger/voucher to create a new voucher with date = today (or specified date)
8. Add voucher line: debit account 6340, amount 44500 NOK, linked to dimension 'Prosjekttype' value 'Internt'
9. Add balancing voucher line: credit counter-account, amount 44500 NOK
10. Confirm voucher is posted and appears in ledger with correct dimension tag via GET /v2/ledger/voucher/{id}

planned_endpoints.summary: Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.
Create a new free (aka 'user defined') accounting dimension
Create a new value for one of the free (aka 'user defined') accounting dimensions

rules: ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.

When using vatType != 0 (e.g. VAT 25%), include ONLY the debit posting with the GROSS amount (incl VAT). Tripletex auto-generates VAT split and credit posting. If this fails with a balance error, fall back to manual postings for all legs.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Always resolve account numbers via GET /ledger/account?number=XXXX first, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.
Postings with vatType={"id":0} (exempt) can include both debit and credit lines manually.

what_worked: Parallelized account lookups and dimension creation, then dimension value creation, minimizing sequential waits.
Correctly used freeAccountingDimension1 with dimensionIndex 1 and vatType 0 for a clean balanced voucher.
what_to_try_next: Consider skipping the second GET /ledger/account call (for account 1920) by hardcoding a known bank account ID if it's stable across runs, saving one call.
